newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil seen unchanged, Brent 5-10 cts up.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil seen unchanged, Brent 5-10 cts up.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures were called to open steady on Monday, while Brent was expected to open between five and 10 cents higher.
Trading on both contracts closed early on Friday due to a power failure at the IPE. August gas oil ended at $167.50 a tonne, while September Brent closed at $18.53 a barrel.
"Because they closed early we're looking at the arbitrage, and Brent is due a little bit higher against (NYMEX crude)," said one broker.
Strong U.S. gasoline, buoyed by a shortage of a blending component, was the key driver behind the market on Friday.
